title: fix(plugin-security)!: an app-authored elevation sees through the organization wall what its caller's plain door sees
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 多组织部署里，没有选中组织的已登录用户触发的动作脚本、系统钩子、系统流程，读租户数据得到空结果，写入被拒并提示缺少当前组织；选了组织的用户不受影响。
- 安全加固：系统身份只提升业务权限，不越过组织墙，与该用户直接访问数据时一致。
- 依赖"无组织时动作仍能跨组织读写"的自定义脚本会改为空结果或 403；定时任务等无调用者的系统工作不变；可整体回退本 PR。
- 无。

## What changes

The rule: **an app-authored elevation sees through the organization wall exactly what its caller's plain door sees.** Elevation lifts a caller's business rules (object and field permissions, ownership, sharing); it never lifts the organization wall (ADR-0095 D1, ADR-0123 D1/D2).

- `@objectstack/plugin-security`: an action body, a hook that runs as system and a flow that runs as system (the elevations the identity-assignment refusal already names, read by the same predicate, `elevationSource`) are held, ahead of the data middleware's system short-circuit, to the organization wall of the caller they run for. The wall is the caller's own Layer 0 over the caller's own context and permission sets, so its exemptions are the plain door's.
  - When it denies the caller (no active organization under `isolated`, an empty membership set under `group`, a person outside every organization under `single`): a read of a tenant-scoped object resolves to nothing (the wall's deny sentinel on the predicate, as the plain door composes it), and a write (insert, update, delete, purge, restore) is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, naming the missing active organization.
  - Not moved: a caller with an active organization (and pays no extra resolution); an elevation that runs for no caller (a scheduled run); every platform system context.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: register row 1c states the rule; the generated site register is rebuilt.
- `.changeset/sec2-wf9p.md`: `patch`, BREAKING banner, FROM/TO.

Landing: the one predicate is plugin-security's, where the organization wall lives (`tenant-layer.ts`) and where the predicate the order names is already read; no `packages/spec/**` edit.

## Why

Security hardening (no-card order of the security seat). The governing text is ADR-0095 D1 and ADR-0123 D1/D2; the maintainer's ruling chose this rule at the single predicate.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/organizations/src/elevated-organization-wall.wall.test.ts` — real stack (`bootStack`: auth, security, app plugin, automation, `OrganizationsPlugin`, `isolated`, invite-only), every action through `POST /api/v1/actions/...`, the active organization cleared through the product's own `set-active` door.
  - With no active organization, for each elevated kind (action handler in code, declared action body, system hook, system flow): a read pin (nothing read) and a write pin (refused `403` / `PERMISSION_DENIED` naming the missing active organization, nothing written) — 9 cases.
  - Controls: with an active organization each kind keeps exactly its organization's reach (5 cases); a platform system context and a caller-less run are unchanged (1 case); premise (1 case).
  - **Red on the base, green after:** base `c448c615` — 9 failed / 7 passed (every no-organization case red, every control green); head — 16 / 16 passed.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/app-automation-organization-wall.test.ts` — the module's pins per elevated kind (read sentinel, write refusal `code` + `status`, the controls, which contexts the rule reads).
- **Guard ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` + `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`): the middleware's call disabled → plugin-security rebuilt, mutation proven live in `dist/` → the pin went red, 9 failed / 7 passed (the same nine) → source restored (`git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, mutation proven absent from `dist/`, tree clean → 16 / 16 green. A first attempt was refused by the tool before running (its replacement contained the anchor) and measured nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- The rule binds an elevation that carries a caller (a `userId`, or the guest entry's envelope). An elevation with no caller (a scheduled run, a record-change run fired by a write with no user) has no door and no active organization to miss, and is unchanged; the examples' scheduled system flows rely on that.
- A write from a denied elevation is refused `403` whatever its verb, delete included; the plain door's by-id delete for the same caller answers `404`.
- The write PREVIEW's per-row wall verdict (`writeWallVerdict`, register row 6c) still answers "not asked" for a system context; unchanged here.
